skill_recommendations.default: Build a small project using {skill} and add it to your resume with measurable impact (e.g. performance, users, or time saved).
skill_recommendations.Python: Take an advanced Python course and contribute to an open-source Python project to strengthen this core skill.
skill_recommendations.SQL: Practice writing complex SQL queries (joins, window functions) on platforms like LeetCode or HackerRank.
skill_recommendations.Django: Build a Django web application with authentication, CRUD operations, REST APIs, and database integration.
skill_recommendations.Flask: Build a Flask application with REST APIs, authentication, database integration, and proper project structure.
skill_recommendations.REST API: Build and document REST APIs using Python and test them with Postman.
skill_recommendations.Docker: Containerize one of your existing projects with Docker and document the setup in your resume.
skill_recommendations.AWS: Complete the AWS Cloud Practitioner certification and deploy a personal project on AWS Free Tier.
skill_recommendations.Machine Learning: Complete a hands-on ML course and build an end-to-end ML project.
skill_recommendations.System Design: Study system design fundamentals and practice designing a scalable service such as a URL shortener or chat application.
skill_recommendations.React: Build a multi-page React application with state management and deploy it to showcase on your resume.
skill_recommendations.Git: Practice branching, merging, and pull requests using Git and host your projects on GitHub.
